screenshots.title: Saltbush, the basin and the track from the ridge
screenshots.alt: First-person view from a ridge on Saltbush: a dirt track winding across a dry grassy basin between rocky hills, an A88 rifle with its optic held at the bottom right.
screenshots.note: A presentation view from the pre-alpha build with the HUD hidden, not a gameplay capture. Saltbush is in production: no navigation audit has signed it off.

screenshots.title: 3 ACR portrait
screenshots.alt: A soldier in Australian camouflage and a helmet, rifle raised, standing on a ridge above an open valley in the dry hills.
screenshots.note: Character model in progress; a presentation view, not gameplay.

screenshots.title: MAF portrait
screenshots.alt: A soldier in Murasian desert camouflage and a helmet with goggles pushed up, holding a rifle on a ridge above an open valley.
screenshots.note: Character model in progress; a presentation view, not gameplay.

screenshots.title: Red Gum, the spawn vehicles at the drop-off
screenshots.alt: Low camera past a Bushmaster and a second armoured vehicle parked on red earth under gum trees, late afternoon.
screenshots.note: Spawn vehicles are static scenery: no crew, no movement. The Bushmaster and ASLAV are named Mulga and Thorny Devil in the project. Frame taken from the 60 s showcase video, so it is video-compressed.

screenshots.title: Class select, the Rifleman
screenshots.alt: The Select Class screen: five roles listed on the left (Rifleman, Medic, Machine Gunner, Sniper, Grenadier) and a camouflaged soldier with an EF88 rifle on a display stage on the right.
screenshots.note: Front-end design is provisional. Frame taken from the 60 s showcase video, so it is video-compressed.

screenshots.title: Red Gum, first person at North Paddock
screenshots.alt: First-person view across red earth towards a parked van, with the EF88 and its optic at the bottom right, a minimap at top left, an objective panel at top right and ammo and health at the bottom.
screenshots.note: The EF88 reload animation is not finished, so reloads are not shown. Frame taken from the 60 s showcase video, so it is video-compressed.

screenshots.title: Saltbush farmyard, a squad firefight
screenshots.alt: Six soldiers in two groups firing and moving across a sandy yard beside a timber farmhouse, a wooden water tank on a tower and a kangaroo in the frame.
screenshots.note: Staged positions with the game's own bot AI doing the fighting. Pre-alpha. Frame taken from the 60 s showcase video, so it is video-compressed.

screenshots.title: Saltbush farmyard, muzzle flash
screenshots.alt: Soldiers crouched and moving around a wooden water tower beside a timber farmhouse, one muzzle flash lighting the ground.
screenshots.note: Pre-alpha. Muzzle-light bloom on nearby ground is still being tuned. Frame taken from the 60 s showcase video, so it is video-compressed.

screenshots.title: Saltbush, the farmhouse
screenshots.alt: Close view of a weathered timber farmhouse with a shuttered window, a door, stacked firewood and a small porch with chairs.
screenshots.note: Assembled from a Fab pack; the pieces carry no collision yet. Frame taken from the 60 s showcase video, so it is video-compressed.

screenshots.title: Red Gum, the Bushmasters at the drop-off
screenshots.alt: First-person view across red earth towards two camouflaged Bushmaster protected mobility vehicles parked with their lights off, a timber shack beside them and gum trees behind, an MAG58 light support gun with a bipod held at the bottom right.
screenshots.note: Pre-alpha, captured in the editor's play mode with the HUD hidden. The Mag58 hold is provisional; the vehicles are static scenery: no lights, no crew, no movement.

screenshots.title: Walking up to the Bushmasters, Red Gum
screenshots.alt: A short looping clip from first person: walking across a red-earth clearing towards two Bushmaster vehicles parked with their lights off, an MAG58 held at the bottom right.
screenshots.note: Pre-alpha; a looping clip, no audio. It is not real time: the frames were captured one at a time.

screenshots.title: Red Gum, Bushmaster patrol vehicles
screenshots.alt: Two camouflaged Bushmaster protected mobility vehicles parked at the Team One drop-off on red earth under gum trees, seen from the side with a timber shack behind them.
screenshots.note: Pre-alpha; the viewer's own side sees Bushmasters here, the other side sees a GAZ Tigr. The vehicles are static scenery.

screenshots.title: Red Gum, the old shack
screenshots.alt: A weathered timber shack with a corrugated iron roof and a stone chimney among gum trees on red earth, an MAG58 held at the bottom right.
screenshots.note: Pre-alpha; the shack is a cleared asset-pack building.

screenshots.title: Red Gum, the road and the wire
screenshots.alt: Barbed-wire fence posts in the foreground on red earth, a kangaroo warning sign beside a bitumen road on the right and a shack among the gum trees ahead.
screenshots.note: Pre-alpha.

screenshots.title: Red Gum, the A25 and the new HUD
screenshots.alt: First-person view through gum trees and spinifex on red earth, an A25 marksman rifle in a two-handed hold at the bottom right, a teammate running ahead, with the compass, slate minimap, objectives panel, health, four-soldier squad roster and A25 ammunition on screen.
screenshots.note: Pre-alpha, captured at 1440p by the producer; the squad roster shows the four most senior friendly soldiers until squads exist.

screenshots.title: Firing the A88, Red Gum
screenshots.alt: A short looping clip from first person: an A88 fires across a red-earth clearing, with muzzle flash and a tracer, and the ammunition count falling on the HUD.
screenshots.note: Pre-alpha; a looping clip of about a second, no audio.

screenshots.title: Red Gum, the sniper tower
screenshots.alt: A timber watchtower standing among gum trees on red earth, seen from the ground over the barrel and optic of an A88.
screenshots.note: The tower is walkable by a ramp; foliage is a pre-alpha pass.

screenshots.title: Dry River, the ridge tower
screenshots.alt: A timber watchtower on a ridge above a red-earth slope with gum trees and an outstation in the distance.
screenshots.note: Pre-alpha; lighting and dressing are a work in progress.

screenshots.title: 3 ACR rifleman patrol
screenshots.alt: Three soldiers in Australian multicam-pattern uniform, helmets, headsets and webbing, moving past a white picket fence.
screenshots.note: Character models are in progress; the uniform texture is soft at close range.

screenshots.title: MAF section
screenshots.alt: A section of Murasian Armed Forces soldiers in red, olive and cream disruptive camouflage, helmets with goggles, carrying AK-pattern rifles.
screenshots.note: Fictional faction; uniform and gear are in progress.
